stationary_policy: At least one validated RMS convergence field; every native group component RMS and sqrt(2*merit/global_points) must meet its target. RESOLVED rows have zero step, unchanged merit, no Krylov/trial work and unavailable (NaN) linear defect. All nonzero accepted directions retain true defect <=0.1.
limits: 81-point generated fixtures, no discretization accuracy or production speedup/scaling claim.
Species uses artificial transport coefficients; LM uses a low-Reynolds-number fixture with partial intermittency, not transition-front validation.
Native clipping/explicit boundary projection and broader model-bound/near-bound feasibility audits remain open.
Full AD/reverse/mixed/GPU execution is not established by forward syntax checks.
